source: Visual inspection of six final saved-map Unreal screenshots after the second art pass

observations.gate: Textured timber, tiled stone and roof surfaces are clear; 90cm lanterns hang from stone standards; guardian dragons have stone plinths.
observations.martial_court: Battle disk and stairs remain open. Peripheral foliage and hanging lights frame the court.
observations.ranged_rock: Stair connection, walkable shelf and firing surfaces remain visually clear; triplanar stone texture has no vertical UV stretch.
observations.alchemy: Roof tile and timber detail improve depth while the furnace and ritual circle retain readable silhouettes.
observations.overview: Six narrower tall floating peaks frame the continuous ascent; summit beacon is visible above the peak line.
observations.summit: Existing seal ring remains the central landmark, with a separate jade guide halo and vertical light column above.

limitations: Some faceting and self-shadow shapes from the original procedural roof geometry remain. Two-sided shading reduces the most visible missing dark wedges but does not constitute geometry reconstruction.
Distant peak bases remain intentionally visible as floating mountains in the pale cloud sea.
Desktop renderer visual review does not verify headset comfort or VR frame rate.
